title: Stop Chrome downloading its on-device AI model
why: Chrome downloads it (about 4 GB) for its built-in AI features, and fetches it again if the folder is deleted.
cost: Chrome's features that run AI on this Mac stop working; nothing else changes.
changes: profile "MyDiskIsFull: no on-device AI model in Chrome": not installed → installed

profiles.name: MyDiskIsFull: no on-device AI model in Chrome
profiles.description: Made by MyDiskIsFull on this Mac. It holds one Google Chrome setting, for your user only: GenAILocalFoundationalModelSettings = 1, so that Chrome doesn't download its on-device AI model (about 4 GB), and deletes the copy it has. Nothing else is in it: no certificates, accounts, passwords, VPN or remote management, and nothing for other apps or users. While it is installed, Chrome says it is managed by your organization: that is this setting. To undo it, remove this profile, or turn the tweak off in MyDiskIsFull.
